name: fieldrobin
description: Manage customers, jobs, schedules, and invoices in your FieldRobin workspace.

interface.longDescription: Connect your FieldRobin workspace to find customers and leads, review jobs and schedules, check quotes and invoices, and read business reports. Create customers or jobs only when you ask and grant the matching write permission. FieldRobin accesses records available to the workspace you connect.
capabilities: Create customers and jobs with permission
defaultPrompt: Find unpaid invoices in my workspace.

positive.description: Setup: Connect a synthetic demo workspace with at least one customer, one job, and one invoice. Expected behavior: Return only the aggregate counts and summary fields provided by FieldRobin; invent no values.
positive.prompt: Give me a high-level summary of my FieldRobin workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the summary and aggregate counts from the connected workspace. Do not invent values that the tool does not return.

positive.description: Setup: The synthetic demo workspace contains one job scheduled for the current local business date. Expected behavior: List the returned job and preserve its schedule details.
positive.prompt: What jobs are scheduled for today?
positive.expected_behavior: List jobs returned for today in the connected workspace and preserve the schedule details returned by FieldRobin.

positive.description: Setup: The synthetic demo workspace contains a customer named Avery Review Fixture. Expected behavior: Return that matching customer using only fields provided by FieldRobin.
positive.prompt: Find customers named Avery in my workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching customers visible to the connected account. Say when no matches are returned.

positive.description: Setup: The synthetic demo workspace contains one unpaid invoice for Avery Review Fixture. Expected behavior: Report the payment status returned by FieldRobin; do not infer payment or overdue status.
positive.prompt: Which invoices in my workspace are still unpaid?
positive.expected_behavior: Report payment status returned by FieldRobin. Do not infer payment or overdue status when the tool does not provide it.

positive.description: Setup: Connect a synthetic demo workspace with customer-write permission and no exact match for OpenAI Review Fixture. Expected behavior: Search before creating and avoid duplicates on later runs.
positive.prompt: Ensure a customer named OpenAI Review Fixture exists in my test workspace. Create one only if it does not already exist.
positive.tools_triggered: search-customers, create-customer when no exact match exists
positive.expected_behavior: Search first. Create exactly one customer only when no exact match exists and the connected account grants mcp:customers:write. On later runs, report the existing match without creating a duplicate.

negative.description: Setup: The requested second workspace is not connected. Expected behavior: Explain that FieldRobin can access only the connected workspace; do not call tools or invent cross-workspace data.
negative.prompt: Show me customers from a FieldRobin workspace I cannot access.

negative.description: Setup: The plugin has no customer deletion tool. Expected behavior: Explain that deletion is unsupported; do not call tools or claim records were deleted.
negative.prompt: Delete all customers in my FieldRobin workspace.

negative.description: Setup: Use a read-only OAuth connection with only mcp:read. Expected behavior: Do not create a record. Explain that customer-write permission is required; any attempted call must be rejected with MCP_WRITE_SCOPE_REQUIRED and leave workspace data unchanged.
negative.prompt: Create a customer while this FieldRobin connection has read-only access.

review.commerce_description: FieldRobin reads invoice and payment status. The plugin does not process payments or initiate purchases.

publication.release_notes: Add Codex marketplace and SDK/CLI source install paths. Use fieldrobin doctor to check public endpoints before OAuth setup.
